threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'local' coffee means Starbucks, not that tiny place down the alley with the 12-hour brew.
Last Friday on the 333, a guy tried to haggle for his fare with the driver, claiming he was a 'bus enthusiast.' The driver just chuckled and let him on.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Watching a group of kids turn a rainy day into a spontaneous slip-and-slide on the street with trash bags. You just don’t see that everywhere.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a disco ball in a public park, spinning above a ping-pong table full of hipsters on a Sunday morning.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re local when they know to never take the 14 during rush hour—unless they enjoy staring at a wall of people.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 near Market this morning, driver stopped mid-route because a guy was serenading passengers with a ukulele. Muni life, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals party late; many of us are tucked in by midnight, sipping tea and binging series, while they’re still out.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their complete confusion at the Trobada del Llibre. Locals grab books and chat, while newcomers just stand there, lost in the crowd.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Underground' instead of just 'the Tube.' You might as well wear a tourist badge!
Caught a guy on the 36 bus singing to himself, completely off-key, while everyone pretended not to notice. Classic Peckham night vibes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I realized I was home? Hearing a kid shout 'Ich will mehr Döner!' at 8 AM outside my balcony. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar that serves breakfast cocktails made with leftover coffee from the night before. It's quirky but oddly tasty!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they know not to bother waiting for the 22 Fillmore at rush hour; it’ll never show up on time anyway.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 47 downtown today, and a couple was arguing over who left their sandwich in the seat. Classic Muni drama amid the chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just walk into any plaça for tapas; locals know the best ones are hidden down side streets, far from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they order 'una cerveza'. It’s a dead giveaway when they don’t specify the brand or size.
